title: Enterprise Contract Approvals: Dynamic Discount Bands & Escalation Matrix
creator: Priya Desai
description: Define and operationalize an internal approval matrix for enterprise contract discounts and updates to the canonical price book. Deliverables: 1) a clear discount band table (percent and token/commit thresholds) mapped to approvers and SLA for approvals, 2) updated pricebook rows for Dedicated/Private tiers and negotiated add-ons, 3) playbook snippets for Sales & Sales Ops to run pilots, and 4) canonical guidance for responding to common security questionnaire items in enterprise contracts.
updates: 2025-02-13: Kickoff with Sales Ops, Legal, and Finance. Agreed scope: discounts, bundling rules, contract security Q&A templates.

2025-02-19: Draft discount bands proposed (0-10%, 11-25%, 26-40%, 41%+), preliminary thresholds tied to ARR/commit levels and Strategic Partner flags. Sales Ops requested a separate corridor for pilot credits vs committed revenue.

2025-02-24: Finance flagged margin sensitivity for 26-40% band; proposed trade-off: require 12-month commit + minimum MRR floor or additional usage fees. Logged as decision candidate — we need executive sign-off for high-risk deals.

2025-02-28: Legal reviewed escalation matrix. Recommendation: require Legal sign-off for any non-standard contract clauses and for discounts >30% unless Sales VP approves. Added requirement for a security questionnaire escalation path to Security team.

2025-03-03: Prototype approval matrix created in Confluence and sample routing rules for pricing tool (internal quote UI). Sales Ops to trial for three live pilots next week; feedback loop scheduled after first pilot quote.

2025-03-05: PM review with Revenue Ops. Agreed to a one-week pilot scope and to instrument quote outcomes (accept/decline, negotiation, time-to-approve) in Looker dashboard. Next: finalize pricebook edits and prepare Sales enablement memo.
acceptance_criteria: Discount band table published in canonical pricebook (Drive link) and synced to internal quote UI
Approval matrix implemented as a simple routing rule in pricing tool with email alerts to approvers
Sales enablement one-pager and escalation checklist delivered to Sales and AMs
Security questionnaire canned answers for top 10 enterprise questions drafted and approved by Security
Pilot run completed on at least 3 deals and approval/timing metrics collected in Looker
proposed_approval_matrix: Band A: 0-10% -> AE approval. Band B: 11-25% -> Sales Manager + Sales Ops review (<=48h). Band C: 26-40% -> Sales Director + Finance sign-off + Legal review (<=5 business days). Band D: 41%+ or non-standard T&Cs -> CRO + CFO + Legal + Security (executive approval). Strategic Partner exceptions annotated and require VP-level alignment.
pricebook_changes_summary: Introduce explicit rows for Dedicated reserved tiers with 12/24/36 month commit discounts, create a separate SKU for Private on-prem setup fees (non-discountable below 6-month commits), and standardize add-on pricing for additional dedicated GPUs and premium observability retention. Mark pilot credits as 'one-time promotional SKUs' and exclude from baseline discount calculations.
security_questionnaire_notes: Compile canonical responses for SOC2, encryption-at-rest/transit, KMS integration, data residency, and incident response. For any question requiring audit artifacts, route to Security (security-answers@redwood.ai). Flag responses that materially change data-handling commitments for Legal review.
next_steps: Finalize pricebook edits and push PR to pricing-config repo (assigned to Finance Engineer)
Enable trial routing in quote UI for Sales Ops (target: 2025-03-10)
Produce Sales enablement memo and host training (owner: Miguel Alvarez)
Run pilot on 3 live opportunities and capture metrics in Looker (owner: Sales Ops)
Security to publish canned Q&A and attach to contract templates (owner: Security)
Executive sign-off on Band C and D approval thresholds (owner: Head of Revenue)
